description: This file defines a class ByteBufferOutputStream that extends OutputStream and provides an implementation backed by a ByteBuffer to facilitate writing bytes to a ByteBuffer.

classes.name: ByteBufferOutputStream
classes.description: A custom OutputStream implementation that writes data into a given ByteBuffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a single byte to the ByteBuffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes an array of bytes to the ByteBuffer with specified offset and length.
